'''Trel Nu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Asylum]] she travelled to [[Odessen]] and joined the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. She was assigned to the [[Force Enclave]] branch of the Alliance under [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]] [[Sana-Rae]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trel Nu appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion as a Jedi Consular vendor inside [[Alliance base|Odessen base]].

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{1st}}
